issue create --title swarm-idle-report.sh needs gawk: its test fails on mawk hosts (function asort never defined) --label swarm-followup --label from-pr-684 --body ## Finding 
 From PR #684 follow-up 2. `tests/test-shape-idle-report.sh` fails on a host whose awk is mawk, with "function asort never defined", because `scripts/swarm-idle-report.sh` uses the gawk-only `asort`. 
  
 ## Do 
 Either require gawk in the docs/preflight, or rewrite the sort without `asort`. 
  
 ## Acceptance 
 `tests/test-shape-idle-report.sh` passes on a mawk-only host, or preflight names gawk as a requirement.

issue create --title test-codex-support.sh is timing-sensitive: 4-second listener timeout failed once in 8 runs --label swarm-followup --label from-pr-685 --body ## Finding 
 From PR #685 follow-up 2. `tests/test-codex-support.sh` runs the listener under a 4-second timeout (line 57 at the time of the PR) and failed once in 8 runs; 6 consecutive reruns and master were green. Cause not established. 
  
 ## Do 
 Widen that timeout, or poll for the expected output. 
  
 ## Acceptance 
 The test no longer depends on a fixed 4-second window. 
  
 — drafted by claude
